how: Night palette as data (environment.sky.night: zenith/horizon/ground/fog/dim/exposure/emissiveBoost — deep blue-grey defaults, never pitch black). nightMix eases 0..1 over ~5 s in DayNightDriver; per frame it drives sky-dome uniforms, scene fog color (distance fade keeps melting), ridge color, the light rig (moved into SiteLights: ambient+key+fills dim), scene.environmentIntensity (IBL dim, no rebake), and exposure — one smooth cross-fade, no pops, no new lights. Night payoff: emissive parts (floodlights, camera indicators, headlights added to trucks+LV) brighten by emissiveBoost (2.4x) and bloom threshold drops to nightThreshold (0.7) at night. Sun/moon toggle in view controls (default day). Tour: beats accept night:true — one 'Night Shift' beat (CHPP pad under floodlights, travel 6 s covers the fade) inserted before the closing wide, which restores day; tour exit always hands back daylight. CCTV feed at night gets a fixed gain (exposure x1.55 at full night) on the raw pass only.
perf_note: per-frame lerps of a handful of scalars/colors — no allocations, no extra passes, no shadow lights
regression_check: 49 night plant (floodlights glowing), 50 night wide (legible), 51 Night Shift beat with lower-third, 56 day fully restored in pit beat, 54/55 feed legible at night, KPI cards + alerts panel readable in all night shots
caveats: IBL dims via scene.environmentIntensity rather than a night rebake — reflections keep a faint day tint at night (invisible in practice)
